_note: Curated real relationships the position and team formula in engine.js cannot infer. A family link fires across any club and any season, which is the whole reason it has to be written down: two brothers who never played together share no team, no season and no college, so nothing else in the model can see them. IDs are Basketball-Reference player ids, which is what both the seed and the fetch key on. A family whose ids are not in the data simply never fires, which is harmless but also invisible, so build-players.mjs reports every unresolved id rather than letting a typo sit here forever.
